item.tib: dbal che mchog mngon du rol pa'i pho nya bdud mo'i zlog pa
item.coloph: dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyis gtan la phab nas/ lha klu mi yis (yi) gshen gsum la brgyud do/ de gsum la gshen nam mkha' snang ba'i mdog can/ des lo tsa ba g.yung drung blo gsal/ des u rgyan nam mkha' gsal grub dang*/ rgya gar lha bdag sngags grol dang / za hor don yod snying po dang gsum la brgyud do/ de gsum gyis dran pa nam mkha' la brgyud do/ des stong (stang) dmu tsa gyer med/ des sprul sku blo ldan snying po/ des rgo (sgo) rigs rgyal ba'i mtshan can/ de'i drung du bdag 'gru rigs shes rab 'od zer gyis zhus so//
